name: clawd-tracker
description: A Domino's-style order tracker above the prompt: Reading, Prepping, Cooking, Taste test, Delivered. Clawd acts out every step (reading, searching, cooking, testing, juggling subagents...) next to live ETA, tokens, context and cost.

showCost.title: Show cost estimate
showCost.description: Show the ≈$ figure (API list prices; on Pro/Max you are not billed per token).

showPlanUsage.title: Show plan usage
showPlanUsage.description: Show your 5-hour and weekly limit usage, and warn once at 90%.
